samson.title: File:China Painting Way to see Baroque Samson Agonistes Square (Czech).jpg
samson.description:
I found it's very interesting:
It's by accident that I came across this picture... 
At that moment, I am going to take my lunch in the Chinese restaurant nearby. 
Suddenly, I found a very traditional Chinese painting way -Window-framing to make my landmark picture. Meanwhile, I felt quite fine that the western square and eastern fashion can join together in a harmony. You knew Golden Yellow colour is for kingdom breath, red lantern is for commons' happyness, and the green plant is for vitality... 

A very fast hand, I did pick it up... in my trip...
